10 Best Budget Hotels in Koh Samui
Real Value

heroSub: Ten wallet-friendly stays on Koh Samui we've reviewed in depth, every one scoring 8.0+ — from a beachfront social hostel in Chaweng for under a thousand baht and a boho boutique on Bophut's walking street, to a 4-star beachfront hotel in central Chaweng and quiet sunset-side beach resorts on Lamai and Lipa Noi. Prices start around ฿900–2,900/night.

breadcrumbSchema.name: 10 Best Budget Hotels in Koh Samui

introH2: 🏝️ Can you really do Samui on a budget — and which area gives the best value?
introHtml: Koh Samui is famous for five-figure pool villas and five-star beachfront resorts, but the island hides far more well-rated stays in the low-thousands-of-baht range than most people expect — a beachfront hostel with two pools, design-led boutiques on a walkable street, and resorts where you open the door straight onto sand, all at a fraction of the luxury tier's price. · The key to doing Samui on a budget is matching the area to your trip, because each of the island's beaches has a different mood and a different price point — Chaweng is the busiest, walkable to the mall and nightlife; Bophut / Fisherman's Village is an atmospheric walking street lined with affordable boutiques; Lamai has the island's biggest cluster of budget beach resorts; and Lipa Noi on the west coast is the quiet, sunset-facing corner for people who came to switch off. · This guide gathers 10 budget stays in Koh Samui we've reviewed in depth, every one scoring 8.0 or higher — all drawn from reading real guest reviews, with the honest upsides and trade-offs of each, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Koh Samui has no metro. Getting around means rental cars, rented scooters, private taxis, songthaews (red trucks) and hotel transfers; Grab exists but is limited and inconsistent. · Samui Airport (USM) sits in the north of the island, closest to Chaweng and Bophut (~10–15 min), with the south and west getting progressively farther. · The areas in this guide: Chaweng beachfront — the longest, liveliest beach, walkable to Central Festival mall, restaurants, bars and clubs (Lub d, OZO) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village — an atmospheric seafront walking street lined with affordable boutiques, close to the airport (Dreamcatcher, Hacienda) · Lamai Beach — the island's biggest cluster of budget beach resorts, walkable to the night market and Lamai walking street (Samui Jasmine, Pavilion, Lamai Wanta, Aloha) · Bang Por / Mae Nam — a quiet northern area with sea-view stays on the hillside (Code Samui) · Lipa Noi — the west coast, calm and quiet, with the sun setting straight into the sea (Lipa Bay) · For most budget stays a rented scooter or car is worth it, since crossing the island by taxi on Samui costs more than you'd think.

entries.type: Boho Boutique Hotel 3★ · Fisherman's Village, Bophut
entries.name: Dreamcatcher Boutique Hotel
entries.revCount: 9.1 · 535 reviews · small boutique on Bophut's walking street
entries.badge: 🏆 Best value in the set · 9.1 for around ฿1,400
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Heart of Fisherman's Village, Bophut · cross the road to the beach · ~5 km from the airport
tags: 🪶 Boho design, no two rooms alike
🚶 Cross the road to Bophut beach
entries.storyHtml: A 9.1 from 535 reviews at around ฿1,400/night is exactly why Dreamcatcher Boutique Hotel lands as the best value in this set — a small, boho-styled boutique right on the Fisherman's Village walking street in Bophut, where no two rooms look the same: woven-bamboo ceilings, polished-cement walls in turquoise tones, dreamcatchers, and both single-storey rooms and photogenic duplex lofts. · Real reviews consistently praise a location where you cross the road to reach the beach, with restaurants, bars and markets all around, the Nomad rooftop bar for sunset drinks, and an airport just ~5 km away — ideal for a first or last night of the trip. · Honest trade-offs from the reviews: it's a small boutique with no pool, there's no lift so you climb stairs, it sits on a bar-lined street that gets music on Friday and Saturday nights, and some room types have weak AC. · Best for couples, solo travellers and photographers who want design on a budget over full-resort facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm at booking that you're getting an AC room, and ask for an inner or upper-floor room away from the bar street if you're a light sleeper. · Try a duplex loft with its mezzanine and balcony — the most photogenic layout. · The hotel lends free drinking water, snorkel gear and sunscreen, so use them. · Book ahead in high season, as room numbers are limited.
pros: 9.1 from 535 reviews at the lowest boutique price here — best value in the set
Boho design with every room different, great photos, comfy beds, big bathrooms
Right in Fisherman's Village, cross the road to the beach, everything around you (from reviews)
Nomad rooftop bar for sunsets · only ~5 km from the airport
cons: Small boutique with no pool, and no lift — you climb stairs
On a bar street; some rooms hear music on Fri–Sat nights (from reviews)
Some room types have weak AC — check the room type before booking

entries.type: Social Hostel 3★ · Chaweng beachfront · dorms + private rooms
entries.name: Lub d Koh Samui Chaweng Beach
entries.badge: 🎒 Cheapest + highest score in the set · from ฿900
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chaweng beachfront · walk to the nightlife · ~12 min from the airport
tags: 🛏️ Dorm beds with curtains + private plugs
🎉 Social vibe, easy to meet people
entries.storyHtml: If keeping costs down is the priority, Lub d Koh Samui Chaweng Beach is the stay that's both the cheapest and the highest-scoring here at once — a social hostel on Chaweng beachfront with dorm beds from around ฿900/night, yet a 9.3 from 240 reviews. · Its heart is what hostels at this price rarely offer: two swimming pools, a beach bar and a beach club, plus well-designed dorm beds where each has a curtain, plug and reading light, with female, mixed and private 'The Duo' rooms to suit your budget. · Real reviews praise the sociable atmosphere where it's easy to meet people, friendly staff, and a Chaweng beachfront location within walking distance of restaurants and nightlife, just ~12 minutes from the airport. · Honest trade-offs: it's a party-leaning social hostel, so evenings are lively, dorm prices run higher than typical island hostels, and checkout is fairly strict. · Best for solo travellers, friend groups and social types who want beach and pools on a shoestring — not those chasing peace and privacy.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For privacy, choose a Duo room and ask for one away from the bar and pool. · If you're here to socialise, a dorm bed is cheaper and easier for meeting people. · It's very close to the airport — ideal for a first or last night. · Beds and rooms fill fast in high season (Dec–Feb), so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate.
pros: Cheapest in the set (from ฿900) and the highest score (9.3) at the same time
2 pools, a beach bar and a beach club — rare at hostel prices
Clean, well-designed dorms with curtains and private plugs per bed (from reviews)
Chaweng beachfront, walk to nightlife · only ~12 min from the airport
cons: A social/party hostel — lively evenings, not for those seeking quiet
Dorm prices run higher than typical island hostels (from reviews)
Fairly strict checkout · fills fast in high season

entries.name: OZO Chaweng Samui
entries.revCount: 8.5 · 1,148 reviews · biggest review base in the set
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Chaweng Beach · beachfront · walk to Central Festival · ~15 min from the airport
tags: 🏖️ On Chaweng Beach, walk to mall & nightlife
🛏️ Rooms built for sleep (blackout curtains, soundproofing)
entries.addr: 11/34 Moo 2, Chaweng Beach Road, Bophut, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: For a 4-star beachfront hotel in central Chaweng that still fits a budget, OZO Chaweng Samui proves itself with the biggest review base in this set — 1,148 reviews, an 8.5, and a start price around ฿2,500/night, for a hotel that sits directly on Chaweng Beach and is a few minutes' walk from Central Festival, restaurants, bars and clubs. · What real reviews single out is rooms built for sleeping the OZO way — soft beds, blackout curtains, soundproofed walls — so you rest well even in a busy district, plus a beachfront pool and kids' pool that suit families, and a breakfast buffet with egg and noodle stations that gets frequent mentions. · Honest trade-offs: it's in the middle of a lively area, some road-facing rooms hear nightlife, certain room types are small with limited storage, and high-season prices climb quickly. · Best for travellers who want a beachfront base within walking distance of everything at a still-reasonable price — not those after quiet privacy.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a pool- or beach-side room on a higher floor — quieter than the road side — and pack earplugs if you sleep lightly. · If budget allows, upgrade to a Deluxe Ocean View for a clearer sea outlook than the entry room. · Don't skip the breakfast buffet at EAT. · Book ahead in high season, as sea-view and beachfront rooms fill fast.
pros: On Chaweng Beach in the centre, walk to Central Festival and nightlife
Biggest review base in the set (1,148) — reliable · a 4-star from ฿2,500
Rooms built for sleep — soft beds, blackout curtains, sleep well (from reviews)
Beachfront pool + kids' pool for families · breakfast buffet reviewers rate
cons: In a lively central area; some road-facing rooms hear nightlife
Some room types are small with limited storage (from reviews)
High-season prices climb quickly — compare across platforms

entries.name: Samui Jasmine Resort
entries.revCount: 8.9 · 640 reviews · highest-scoring beach resort in the set
entries.badge: 🌸 Highest-scoring beach resort in the set · 8.9
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Lamai Beach, mid-strip · walk to Lamai walking street
tags: 🏖️ On Lamai Beach, mid-strip, free sun loungers
entries.addr: 131/8 Moo 3, Lamai Beach, Maret, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Among Samui's budget beach resorts, Samui Jasmine Resort is the highest-scoring in this set — a 35-room beachfront boutique in the middle of Lamai, an 8.9 from 640 reviews, from around ฿2,900/night. · What real reviews praise most is the seafront saltwater pool that stays open late, facing the Gulf and flowing visually out to the sea, plus a white-sand beach with free loungers and umbrellas, and staff guests mention again and again as warm — remembering names and helping with a smile, enough to bring people back. · The location also walks to Lamai's walking street, restaurants and massage shops within minutes. · Honest trade-offs: it's a small boutique without big-resort facilities (no full kids' club or gym), some rooms are starting to show their age, and being mid-strip means road-facing rooms may hear bar music on weekend nights. · Best for couples and small families who want a mid-strip beachfront stay on a controlled budget, valuing location and service over luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If budget allows, pick a Sea View room or Deluxe Villa over the garden-view rooms for a better setting. · Light sleepers should ask for a room facing the garden or sea at booking and confirm at check-in. · Book with breakfast included, served by the sea. · Grab a poolside or beachfront lounger early — they're popular.
pros: 8.9, the highest score among the beach resorts here, from 640 reviews
Seafront saltwater pool open late + white-sand beach with free loungers, step onto the sand
Warm, family-style staff who remember names — a repeat-visit highlight (from reviews)
Central location, walk to Lamai walking street and restaurants
cons: Small boutique without big-resort facilities
Some rooms starting to show their age, limited storage (from reviews)
Bars nearby; road-facing rooms may hear music on weekend nights

entries.type: Design Suite Hotel 4★ · Bang Por hillside (Mae Nam)
entries.name: Code Samui Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Por hillside · Mae Nam area · ~3-min shuttle to the beach (not beachfront)
tags: 🛋️ Big suites with a kitchen, good for long stays
🤫 Quiet and private, great for couples
entries.addr: 55/13 Moo 6, Bang Por Soi 4, Mae Nam, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: If you want a wide sea view and an infinity pool at a price you'd normally pay more for, Code Samui Hotel makes it possible — a 4-star design-suite hotel on the Bang Por hillside where every room is a suite facing the Gulf at 180°, with floor-to-ceiling glass opening onto a private balcony and views out to the sea and Koh Phangan on clear days, an 8.8 from 827 reviews, from around ฿2,800/night. · Nearly every real review mentions the cliff-edge infinity pool that meets the horizon, the spacious suites with in-room kitchens that suit long stays, the quiet and private feel, and staff whose care is the most-praised point. · Honest trade-offs to accept before booking: it's not beachfront — it's up a hill, with a ~3-minute shuttle down to Bang Por beach, the internal paths are steep with lots of stairs, the Bang Por area is fairly remote from shops and dining, and some rooms report inconsistent hot water and water pressure. · Best for couples, design lovers and anyone wanting a quiet sea-view suite over stepping straight onto sand.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book in low season — noticeably better rates. · If stairs are hard, ask for a room near the lobby or pool and check the beach-shuttle schedule. · Bang Por is remote, so a rented car or scooter helps. · Make the most of the in-room kitchen on longer stays.
pros: Every room a 180° sea-view suite with floor-to-ceiling glass, spacious with a kitchen
Cliff-edge infinity pool nearly every review mentions · a 4-star from ฿2,800
Quiet and private, great for couples · attentive staff (from reviews)
Large review base of 827 — reliable
cons: Not beachfront — up a hill, ~3-min shuttle to Bang Por beach
Steep internal paths, lots of stairs · Bang Por is remote from shops (from reviews)
Some rooms report inconsistent hot water/pressure and minor maintenance

entries.type: Beachfront Boutique Hotel 3★ · Fisherman's Village, Bophut
entries.name: Hacienda Fisherman's Village
entries.revCount: 8.6 · 152 reviews · beachfront boutique with a rooftop pool
entries.badge: 🌅 Beachfront boutique, rooftop bay-view pool · from ฿1,600
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Beachfront, heart of Fisherman's Village, Bophut · walk the walking street
tags: 🏖️ Beachfront in the heart of Fisherman's Village
entries.addr: 98 Moo 1, Fisherman's Village, Bophut, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Another beachfront boutique in the heart of Fisherman's Village that delivers on a low-thousands budget, Hacienda Fisherman's Village is a white, Mediterranean-style hotel where you step out onto the walking street and Bophut beach right away, an 8.6 from 152 reviews, from around ฿1,600/night. · What real reviews single out most is the rooftop pool and solarium overlooking Bophut Bay, the old fishing pier and nearby islands — a favourite sunset spot — along with sweet, clean rooms that have Netflix TVs and private balconies, in one of Samui's best locations without needing to drive anywhere. · Honest trade-offs: there's no lift, so you take stairs up to upper rooms and the rooftop pool, the pool is small (more a cool-off dip than a swim), there's no on-site parking as it's in the walking-street zone, and road-facing rooms may hear nightlife on weekends. · Best for couples and budget travellers who want a walkable beachfront base and don't mind a small pool or stairs.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head up to the rooftop pool at sunset — that's the highlight. · If budget allows, pick a Sea View room overlooking Bophut Bay, or ask for a quieter inner room. · If stairs are hard, request a lower-floor room at booking (no lift). · Reconfirm your booking with the hotel before you travel.
pros: Beachfront in the heart of Fisherman's Village, walk to restaurants and the walking street
Rooftop pool and solarium over Bophut Bay — a popular sunset spot (from reviews)
Clean, sweetly styled rooms with Netflix TV and balcony, from ฿1,600
Friendly staff who book tours, call taxis and recommend local spots
cons: No lift — stairs up to upper rooms and the rooftop pool
Small pool, more a cool-off dip · no on-site parking
Road-facing rooms may hear nightlife on weekends (from reviews)

entries.type: Beachfront Resort · Lamai Beach · with private-pool villas
entries.name: Pavilion Samui Villas & Resort
entries.revCount: 8.4 · 971 reviews · 2 big seafront pools + pool villas
entries.badge: 🏡 Private-pool villas at gentler prices · 2 big pools
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Lamai Beach, mid-strip · walk to the Lamai Sunday night market
tags: 🏖️ On Lamai Beach, mid-strip, free loungers
🏡 Private-pool villas at gentler prices than top brands
🚶 Walk to the Lamai Sunday night market
entries.addr: 124/24 Moo 3, Maret, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: For a beachfront resort with big pools and an option to upgrade to a private-pool villa at gentler prices than the top brands, Pavilion Samui Villas & Resort is a mid-Lamai pick with a solid 971-review base, an 8.4, from around ฿2,800/night. · Real reviews praise the two big seafront pools facing the Gulf, plenty of loungers, a beach bar and a well-kept beach with free loungers; the location is truly on the sand yet still walks to the Lamai Sunday night market, restaurants, bars and a 7-Eleven, and staff score as high as 9.2 with guests. · Room choices run from entry rooms up to hydro-pool rooms, a beachfront pool villa and a two-bedroom Grand Pool Villa. · Honest trade-offs: the resort is renovating in phases, so some rooms show their age, older AC units can be noisy at night, some rooms have open layouts with bathrooms that aren't fully enclosed, and its own value score sits at 8.2, its lowest. · Best for those who value a beachfront location and service over brand-new polish.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If budget allows, try a pool villa or hydro-pool room for more privacy. · Ask for a recently renovated room/villa set back from the bar street for something newer and quieter. · If you dislike open-plan bathrooms, check the room layout and request a fully enclosed one before confirming. · Booking in low season is noticeably better value.
pros: Genuinely on Lamai Beach mid-strip, 2 big seafront pools, step onto the sand
Private-pool villas and hydro-pool rooms at gentler prices than top brands
Smiling, helpful staff (9.2 staff score) · 971-review base
Walk to the Lamai Sunday night market, restaurants, bars and a 7-Eleven
cons: Renovating in phases; some rooms show their age, older AC can be noisy at night
Some rooms have open layouts with bathrooms not fully enclosed (from reviews)
Own value score of 8.2, its lowest · road-side rooms hear bars

entries.name: Lamai Wanta Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Lamai Beach, mid-strip · walk to the night market and restaurants
entries.addr: 124/264 Moo 3, Maret, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: If you want a beachfront stay with an infinity pool on Samui from around two thousand baht, Lamai Wanta Beach Resort is a Lamai beachfront resort that genuinely hits that price with a solid 747-review base and an 8.0. · Its clear selling point is the seafront infinity pool facing Lamai Beach, with a kids' pool and a view that carries out to the sea — the part guests like most — plus a mid-strip location where you open the garden door onto the sand yet still walk to restaurants, bars, the night market and a 7-Eleven. · Real reviews praise the leafy tropical garden, smiling and helpful staff, and value for the money. · Honest trade-offs: the block-400 rooms sit near a bar with loud music at night, the buildings and rooms are aging in a simple, no-frills style, and the green garden has mosquitoes — bring repellent. · Best for those who want to sleep beachfront mid-strip with a sea-view pool at an accessible price, without expecting a brand-new resort.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Avoid the block-400 rooms near the pub/bar if you sleep lightly, and confirm a block away from the bar street at booking. · Ask for a garden bungalow — brighter and roomier than the ground-floor block rooms. · Bring mosquito repellent. · Grab a poolside lounger early, as they're limited.
pros: Genuinely on Lamai Beach, seafront infinity pool, step onto the sand, from ฿2,000
Mid-strip location, walk to restaurants, bars, the night market and a 7-Eleven
Leafy tropical garden, smiling and helpful staff (from reviews)
Solid 747-review base — reliable for a budget beachfront resort
cons: Block-400 rooms near a bar hear loud music at night
Buildings and rooms aging, simple no-frills style (from reviews)
Mosquitoes in the green garden — bring repellent · repetitive breakfast menu

entries.type: Beachfront Resort 3★ · Lamai Beach · Thai-timber style
entries.name: Aloha Resort Koh Samui
entries.badge: 🌺 On Lamai Beach, seafront pool · from ฿1,800
entries.mrtTag: 📍 On Lamai Beach · walk to Lamai walking street · free parking
tags: 🏖️ On Lamai Beach, walk to the walking street
🏊 Seafront free-form pool + jacuzzi + pool bar
🌺 74 Thai-timber rooms in a tropical garden
entries.addr: 128 Moo 3, Lamai Beach, Maret, Koh Samui
entries.storyHtml: Another beachfront Lamai resort in the low-thousands, Aloha Resort Koh Samui is a 74-room Thai-timber-style resort in a tropical garden that opens onto the white-sand Gulf shore, an 8.0 from 384 reviews, from around ฿1,800/night. · Real reviews single out the seafront free-form pool with a jacuzzi section, kids' pool and beachside pool bar, a view carrying from the pool edge out to the sea, plus a mid-strip location that walks to Lamai's walking street, restaurants and massage shops, and staff guests call a highlight. · Honest trade-offs to understand before booking: this is an older resort, rooms and facilities are getting tired, some rooms have weak or cold hot water and few power sockets, some poolside loungers are old and rusty, and TripAdvisor rates it just 3.3/5 on room condition. · Best for budget couples and families who value the beachfront location and seafront pool above all, pick a higher room category and ask to see the room at check-in.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If budget allows, choose a Grand Deluxe or a more recently refurbished room, and ask to see the room at check-in. · Bring a power strip (few sockets) and mosquito repellent. · Ask for a quieter room if you sleep lightly. · Come mainly for the beachfront location and seafront pool, and the overall value stacks up.
pros: Genuinely on Lamai Beach, seafront free-form pool with jacuzzi and pool bar, step onto the sand
Central location, walk to Lamai walking street, restaurants and massage shops
From ฿1,800 — good value for a beachfront stay · smiling, helpful staff (from reviews)
Leafy tropical garden, relaxed and unhurried · free parking, bike rental
cons: Older resort; rooms and facilities getting tired (TripAdvisor 3.3/5)
Some rooms have weak hot water, AC issues and few sockets (from reviews)
Limited breakfast selection · some poolside loungers old and rusty

entries.type: Beachfront Resort 3★ · Lipa Noi · sunset side
entries.name: Lipa Bay Resort
entries.badge: 🌅 Sunset-side beachfront, calm and quiet · from ฿1,500
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Lipa Noi · west coast · quiet, far from Chaweng/Bophut (a car helps)
tags: 🌅 Sunset side, watch the sun set into the sea
🤫 Calm and quiet, away from the crowds
🏝️ Garden bungalows/villas on the sand, private beach
entries.storyHtml: Closing the set with a quiet corner of Samui for people who came to switch off, Lipa Bay Resort is a beachfront resort of just 18 rooms on Lipa Noi's west coast, an 8.0 from 105 reviews, from around ฿1,500/night. · The selling point reviews mention most is the sunset side of the island, where you watch the sun drop straight into the sea from the pool and beach every evening, plus the calm far from Chaweng and Bophut, a private beach with a gentle shallow slope that suits families with young kids, and garden bungalows and villas in a leafy tropical setting. · Honest trade-offs: some rooms and décor look dated, the location is far from the main tourist areas with few shops nearby so you'll want a vehicle, there's no full-service restaurant open at night, and on some days the pool gets outside day-pass guests. · Best for couples and families who want a calm, sunset-side beachfront corner on a budget and don't need walkable nightlife (we placed it 10th for the smallest review base and most remote location in the set).
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a beachfront or sea-view room to make the most of the sunset. · Rent a car or scooter, as the location is far from the main areas with few shops nearby. · Book a beachfront table for sunset in advance. · In high season this 18-room resort fills its beachfront rooms fast, so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate.
pros: On Samui's sunset side, watch the sun set into the sea from pool and beach
Calm and quiet, away from the crowds; private beach with a gentle shallow slope, good for young kids
Garden bungalows/villas on the sand, good value for a beachfront stay from ฿1,500 (from reviews)
Leafy, private tropical setting · reasonably priced food
cons: Some rooms and décor look dated — not a new resort
Far from Chaweng/Bophut, few shops nearby — you'll want a vehicle (from reviews)
No full-service restaurant open at night · pool sometimes has outside day-pass guests

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season and can change by date and season — always check the live price and compare across 3 sites before booking. · The scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms; we did not stay ourselves. · Every stay in this set scores 8.0+, but these are budget 2–4 star properties, so each has limits for the price — some rooms are aging, some have no lift, some pools are small — please read each stay's trade-offs before booking. · In Samui's high season (December–February) prices rise and small stays like Lub d, Lipa Bay and Dreamcatcher fill first, so plan ahead. · Koh Samui has no metro; for most budget stays a rented scooter or car is best, as cross-island taxis run expensive. · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about budget hotels in Koh Samui

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best-value budget hotel in Koh Samui?
faq.a: On score-for-price, Dreamcatcher Boutique Hotel at 9.1 from around ฿1,400 is the best value in this set. · On the lowest budget, Lub d Koh Samui Chaweng Beach from ฿900 (dorm bed) is both the cheapest and the highest-scoring (9.3) at once. · For a well-rated beach resort, Samui Jasmine Resort at 8.9, or a 4-star beachfront hotel, OZO Chaweng at ฿2,500.

faq.q: ❓ How much do budget hotels in Koh Samui cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start around ฿900–2,900 per night. · The lightest are Lub d from ฿900 (dorm bed), Dreamcatcher ฿1,400, Lipa Bay ฿1,500 and Hacienda ฿1,600. · The beach resorts run Aloha ฿1,800, Lamai Wanta ฿2,000, OZO ฿2,500, Code and Pavilion ฿2,800, and Samui Jasmine ฿2,900. · All are approximate starting rates outside peak season; high season (December–February) climbs noticeably.

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in for a budget Koh Samui trip?
faq.a: It depends on your trip — Chaweng is the liveliest, walkable to the mall and nightlife, good for night owls (Lub d, OZO) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village is an atmospheric seafront walking street with affordable boutiques, close to the airport (Dreamcatcher, Hacienda) · Lamai Beach has the biggest cluster of budget beach resorts, walkable to the night market (Samui Jasmine, Pavilion, Lamai Wanta, Aloha) · Lipa Noi on the west coast is calm, quiet and sunset-facing, best for switching off (Lipa Bay).

faq.q: ❓ Are there genuinely beachfront budget stays on Samui?
faq.a: Yes, several in this set. · Genuinely beachfront (open the door onto sand): Samui Jasmine, Pavilion, Lamai Wanta and Aloha on Lamai, OZO on Chaweng, and Lipa Bay on Lipa Noi. · Dreamcatcher and Hacienda are on Bophut beach, cross the road to the sand. · The exception is Code Samui, up on the Bang Por hillside — not beachfront, a shuttle down to the beach — but you get a sea-view suite and infinity pool instead.

faq.q: ❓ Should I rent a car or scooter if I'm on a budget stay?
faq.a: Strongly recommended for stays away from the main areas. · Koh Samui has no metro, and cross-island private taxis cost more than you'd think, so a rented scooter or car saves money and is far more convenient — especially at Lipa Bay (Lipa Noi) or Code Samui (Bang Por), which are remote from shops. · Stays in Chaweng, Bophut and mid-Lamai (Lub d, OZO, Dreamcatcher, Hacienda, Samui Jasmine, Pavilion, Lamai Wanta, Aloha) walk to restaurants and the beach, so you can manage without a vehicle.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a budget hotel in Koh Samui?
faq.a: In Samui's high season (December–February and Songkran), book 1–2 months ahead, especially small stays like Lipa Bay (18 rooms), Dreamcatcher and Lub d that fill first. In low season, 1–2 weeks is enough and prices drop a lot. · Every platform offers free cancellation, so lock in a rate that way if your plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
